title: 第13章 冷月涵的偶像第14章 把丹药当饭吃金刚丹新的副作用
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
李玄想到这里，当即取出传音玉符，联系上了冷月涵，将自己炼制出“师尊指点版”金刚丹，药效可能更强但也更未知的情况，大致说明了一下。
玉符那头传来的声音，却带着几分急促和厮杀声。
“师弟啊，我现在正打到关键时刻，走不开啊！”
冷月涵的声音听起来有些飘忽：“什么？你师尊指点过的丹药？那肯定没问题！”
“苏峰主是什么人物？！”
“她老人家指点过的东西，还需要试吗？”
“绝对是精品中的精品！”
李玄嘴角抽了抽，总感觉大师姐这话的重点不太对。
“你放心，师弟！”
冷月涵的声音拔高了几度：“你小子别跑，今天不把你装备爆了，我不姓冷！”
片刻后，她才带着几分得意：“你刚才说什么来着，苏晚晴前辈指点过的丹药？！”
她忽然激动起来，以至于说话语速快了很多：“我跟你说，苏晚晴峰主，那可是我冷月涵最最最崇拜的人，没有之一！”
“她就是我辈修士的楷模，丹道界的灯塔！”
“那绝对是极品中的极品啊！”
“有苏前辈的指导，别说是师弟你了，就算是一头猪，也能炼制出来极品丹药！”
“啊，不对！”
“我不是说你是猪啊，你比猪强多……也不对，算了，总之你懂我意思！”
“她指点过的丹药，你给我好好留着！”
“等到了第三**比，我要用偶像的丹药，亲手击败那个该死的富二代！”
“嘿嘿，这下，宗门大比第一名，八千灵石的奖金，稳了！”

“绝对稳了！”
听着大师姐那仿佛已经把八千灵石揣进兜里的语气，李玄一时间竟不知道该说什么。
他还是第一次知道，冷月涵的偶像，竟然是自家师尊。
“行吧，那我给师姐留着。”
李玄无奈道。
“好嘞！师弟，我先不跟你说了，对面那孙子又想抢我怪！”
“看我把他头给锤爆！”
传音玉符的光芒黯淡下去。
李玄摇了摇头，刚准备继续研究一下这极品金刚丹，洞府外的禁制便传来一阵轻微的波动。
“请问，李玄师兄可在洞府？”
“我等在第二**比中侥幸晋级，特来求购金刚丹，助我们再创佳绩！”
声音此起彼伏，听起来人数还不少。
第二**比，帮他彻底打开了销路。
可惜，他之前被师尊叫走后，回来就一门心思炼制新的金刚丹，一直没空接见他们。
打开洞府大门，果然见十来个外门弟子正一脸期盼地等候着。
“诸位师弟客气了。”
李玄拱手道：“金刚丹尚有，不过价格还是老样子。”
“没问题！李师兄，只要能买到丹药，灵石不是问题！”为首的一名弟子立刻拍着胸脯保证。
content_en:
When Li Xuan thought of this, he immediately took out the sound-transmitting jade talisman, contacted Leng Yuehan, and gave a rough explanation of how he had refined the "master's instruction version" of King Kong Dan, which might be more effective but also more unknown.
The voice coming from the other end of the jade talisman was somewhat urgent and fighting.
"Junior brother, I'm at a critical moment now. I can't leave!"
Leng Yuehan's voice sounded a little erratic: "What? The elixir that your master pointed out? That must be no problem!"
"Who is Peak Master Su?!"
"Do you still need to try the things that her old man pointed out?"
“Absolutely the best of the best!”
The corners of Li Xuan's mouth twitched, feeling that the point of what the senior sister said was not quite right.
"Don't worry, junior brother!"
Leng Yuehan's voice rose a few degrees: "You kid, don't run away. If I don't blow up your equipment today, my surname is not Leng!"
After a moment, she said with some pride: "What did you just say, the elixir that Senior Su Wanqing pointed out?!"
She suddenly became so excited that she spoke much faster: "Let me tell you, Peak Master Su Wanqing, that is the person I, Leng Yuehan, admire the most, no one else!"
"She is a role model for monks of our generation and a beacon in the world of alchemy!"
"That is definitely the best of the best!"
"With the guidance of Senior Su, not to mention you, junior brother, even a pig can refine the best elixir!"
"Ah, no!"
"I'm not saying you're a pig, you're much better than a pig...that's not right either, forget it, anyway you know what I mean!"
"Keep the elixir she pointed out for me!"
"When it comes to the third competition, I will use my idol's elixir to defeat that damn rich second generation with my own hands!"
"Hehe, now, the first place in the sect competition, the prize of 8,000 spirit stones, is guaranteed!"
"It's absolutely stable!"
Listening to the senior sister's tone as if she had already put eight thousand spiritual stones in her pocket, Li Xuan didn't know what to say for a moment.
This was the first time he knew that Leng Yuehan's idol was actually his master.
"Okay, then I'll keep it for Senior Sister."
Li Xuan said helplessly.
"Okay! Junior brother, I won't tell you anymore. The grandson opposite wants to rob me again!"
"Watch me blow his head off!"
The light of the sound transmission jade talisman dimmed.
Li Xuan shook his head, and just as he was about to continue studying this top-quality diamond elixir, there was a slight fluctuation in the forbidden area outside the cave.
"Excuse me, is Senior Brother Li Xuan in the cave?"
"We were lucky enough to advance in the second round, and I'm here to buy the Vajra Pill to help us achieve greater success again!"
The voices came and went, and it sounded like there were quite a few people.
The second competition helped him completely open up sales.
It's a pity that after he was called away by his master before, he concentrated on refining new diamond pills when he came back and never had time to meet them.
When I opened the door of the cave, I saw a dozen outer disciples waiting expectantly.
"Junior brothers, you're welcome."
Li Xuan cupped his hands and said: "There are still diamond pills, but the price is still the same."
"No problem! Senior Brother Li, as long as you can buy elixirs, spiritual stones are not a problem!" One of the leading disciples immediately patted his chest and assured.
